reviewScope: Internal engineering/model-consistency and browser viewport review,not independent expert,official-board,physical-device,manufacturer or calibration certification. Chosen densities and tares are reference model parameters. Ideal instantaneous balances,quasi-static incompressible separate liquids;no balance response lag,noise,splashing,evaporation,thermal expansion,jet inventory or calibration uncertainty. Colours identify samples,not density. Equal height implies equal volume only for the identical internal areas used. Undefined inferred density and ratio at zero sample volume. Native text readouts are outside the original balance meshes. Source/receiver inspection crops labelled. No measured FPS,physical printing or pointer-orbit certification.
